## What changed

One concern per pull request.

## Measured or checked

Render time before and after, what you looked at in the viewer, or the case that now works. Say what you could not check.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Docs updated in the same commit: the doc in `docs/` that owns this, README if its claims change, `SKILL.md` if the agent uses it, `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `ROADMAP.md` updated if this builds or tests something listed there
- [ ] No generated output or private files committed
